title: Bảng mô tả tóm tắt môn học Chương trình Tiên tiến
issuer: Trường Đại học Khoa học Tự nhiên, Khoa Công nghệ Thông tin
notes: Downloaded from sourceUrl on 15 November 2026. The PDF itself never enters git; its sha256 is recorded above.
The document prints no date and names no cohort. Its metadata says it was created on 30 July 2019; the URL folder says 2015/07. Neither is an issue date.

Landscape letter pages (792 x 612 pt). The table has seven columns at the same x on all 42 pages: Mã môn, Tên TA, Tên tiếng Việt, Mô tả môn học, Chuẩn đầu ra của môn học, Số tín chỉ, Điều kiện tiên quyết. Each crop takes one column of every page; -H 545 leaves out the page number in the footer.

The whole-page text interleaves the columns line by line, so each cell is read from its column's crop, and the whole-page text only ties a row's code to its credits and the first line of its prerequisite cell.

Narrow columns break words: codes (MTH2 / 51, ECE34 / 1, STAT4 / 51), names (Communicati / on, Internetworki / ng) and prerequisite cells (MATH2 / 51, STAT45 / 1,). The prerequisite cell is kept with one space at each line break.
"Mô tả môn học" and "Chuẩn đầu ra của môn học" are not extracted.
One row carries two codes, CS487-CS488 (Capstone Project, 6 credits). PH215 and PH216 print their credits as "01", PH214 as "1".
The prerequisite cell of MTH346 starts on page 36 and ends on page 37.

Prerequisite cells name codes that are no row of the table: CS200 (CS320, CS333), MATH251 (MTH252, MTH346), MATH252 (MTH253) and MATH261 (CS419). The rows are MTH251, MTH252 and MTH261; CS411 prints MTH261.
Not a rule: nothing loads this table and the rule engine never reads it (AGENTS.md hard rule 1).
